caption: The drawing depicts a section of an ornate wrought iron fence rendered in black pencil or ink on a beige background. The design consists of three vertical bars and one partial bar on the right, all decorated with symmetrical, intricate patterns resembling stylized leaves, scrolls, and floral motifs. At the top of each bar is a pointed finial with additional small, leafy protrusions. Two horizontal bars run across the design, one at the base and one near the top, with the ornate decorative elements filling the spaces between. The composition is centered on the page, leaving a wide plain margin on all sides.
title: Iron Ornament
